description_en: Retrieves the message history and temporary download URLs for Pipeline snapshots of a specified session by session ID
description_zh: 通过会话ID获取指定会话的消息历史和Pipeline快照临时下载地址
name: ListChatMessages

parameters.help_en: The ID of the session to query. You can query only sessions owned by the current user
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的会话 ID。只能查询当前用户拥有的会话
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: A compatibility field. V2 does not return a paged message array, and the service does not consume this field
parameters.help_zh: 兼容字段。V2 当前不按页返回消息数组，服务不消费该字段
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: A compatibility field. V2 does not return a paged message array, and the service does not consume this field
parameters.help_zh: 兼容字段。V2 当前不按页返回消息数组，服务不消费该字段
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: Set this parameter to V2 to route requests to the ROS Agent V2 backend
parameters.help_zh: 传 V2 路由到 ROS Agent V2 后端
parameters.name: agent_version

MaxResults.description_en: A compatibility field. The V2 response does not return MaxResults
MaxResults.description_zh: 兼容字段。V2 当前响应不返回 MaxResults

Messages.description_en: A compatibility field. The V2 response does not return a message array
Messages.description_zh: 兼容字段。V2 当前响应不返回消息数组

items.description_en: A compatibility field. V2 does not return message objects
items.description_zh: 兼容字段。V2 当前不返回消息对象

NextToken.description_en: A compatibility field. The V2 response does not return NextToken
NextToken.description_zh: 兼容字段。V2 当前响应不返回 NextToken

PipelineName.description_en: The pipeline name. Valid values: EvaluationFirstSelling and SolutionFirstSelling
PipelineName.description_zh: 流水线名称，取值为 EvaluationFirstSelling 和 SolutionFirstSelling

PipelineSnapshotDownloadUrl.description_en: The pre-signed download URL for the Pipeline snapshot file a2a-snapshot.json. The URL is valid for 1800 seconds
PipelineSnapshotDownloadUrl.description_zh: Pipeline 的 a2a-snapshot.json 预签名下载 URL，有效期 1800 秒

SessionMessagesDownloadUrl.description_en: The pre-signed download URL for the session messages file session.jsonl. The URL is valid for 1800 seconds
SessionMessagesDownloadUrl.description_zh: 会话消息 session.jsonl 的预签名下载 URL，有效期 1800 秒

Title.description_en: The session title. This value may be empty

WorkspaceTemplates.description_en: The list of ROS templates in the session workspace. This field is returned only for the solution-first flow. If no published templates exist, this field is not returned or an empty array is returned
WorkspaceTemplates.description_zh: 会话工作区中的 ROS 模板列表。仅方案优先流程返回；没有已发布的模板时不返回或返回空数组

items.description_en: The path, availability status, and temporary download URL of a single ROS template
items.description_zh: 单个 ROS 模板的路径、可用状态和临时下载地址

DownloadUrl.description_en: The temporary download URL of the template file. This field is returned only when `Status` is `available`. The URL is valid for 300 seconds. After the URL expires, call this operation again to obtain a new URL
DownloadUrl.description_zh: 模板文件的临时下载地址。仅当 `Status` 为 `available` 时返回，有效期为 300 秒；过期后需重新调用接口获取

Status.description_en:
The download status of the template. Valid values:
`available`: The template is ready for download. The `DownloadUrl` field is also returned.
`not_ready`: The template path has been determined, but the file is not yet ready. Retry later.
`unavailable`: The template cannot be downloaded. For example, the file is too large or the temporary download URL failed to generate
Status.description_zh:
模板的可下载状态。取值如下：
`available`：模板已准备完成，可以下载，同时返回 `DownloadUrl`。
`not_ready`：模板路径已确定，但文件尚未准备完成，请稍后重试。
`unavailable`：模板当前无法下载，例如文件过大或临时下载地址生成失败

TemplatePath.description_en: The relative path of the template in the session workspace. Supported formats: `.yml`, `.yaml`, and `.json`
TemplatePath.description_zh: 模板在会话工作区中的相对路径。支持`.yml`、`.yaml`和`.json`格式
